text:
Maria: Starting the release play for the engine quant kernel bundle. Target change window Thu 23:00-02:00 UTC. Owners: Alex (deploy), Jun (QA), Jon (SRE).
Alex: Ack — I'll run the canary in eu-west-1 at T0+5m, starting at 5%.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: engine:v2.14-quant -> canary 5% eu-west-1. Artifact: sha256:abcdef1234567890. CI: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4287
QA_Jun: Kicking off staged smoke now against staging. Seeing a couple tokenization diffs on long system prompts, will post failing prompts to the release folder.
Sam: FYI if the tokenization diffs touch any user-facing examples we should pin back to v2.13 and abort ramp.
Alex: Plan: observe canary 30m. If p95 delta <8% and error rate <0.3% then ramp to 25% -> 100% over 2h. Rollback thresholds: p95 +10% (sustained 15m) or error rate >0.5% (sustained 10m).
SRE_Jon: I'll add temporary alerts and a PagerDuty escalation on sustained 10% p95 increase. Also tracking infra metrics for KV cache churn.
QA_Jun: Adding failing prompts to /releases/4287/edge_prompts.txt and attaching to the changelog PR.
Docs_Liz: I'll draft release notes calling out int8 quant path and ~30% memory reduction, and mention potential micro-diffs for tokenizer edge cases.
Alex: Deployment command I'll run at start time:
```bash
deploybot release create --image=engine:v2.14-quant --policy=canary --percent=5 --region=eu-west-1
```
Maria: Also confirm package checksum locally before run: `sha256sum engine-v2.14-quant.tar.gz` (expected sha256: abcdef1234567890).
DeployBot: Artifact verified: checksums OK. Canary started at 23:05 UTC.
QA_Jun: Smoke pass: OK. Found 2 non-blocking tokenization diffs logged. Latency p95 +3% in eu-west-1, errors 0.05%.
Alex: If no signals, ramp to 25% in 20m. Rollout playbook link: https://redwood.internal/releaseplay/4287
Sam: Prepare rollback tag and pin plan. If rollback, target image: engine:v2.13-hotfix and run drain before switching.
SRE_Jon: If rollback triggered I'll execute: `deploybot rollback --to=engine:v2.13-hotfix` and halt further ramps; will post incident channel update.
Maria: :thumbsup: After full ramp, cut release note and update model catalog with "quant-enabled" flag.
Docs_Liz: Draft PR opened for release notes: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/1234
Alex: Minor note — watch KV cache refill rate, previous quant builds bumped refill ops. I'll add a trace and a dashboard tile.
DeployBot: Canary metrics (30m): p95 +3%, errors 0.06%, KV refill +12% (within expected bounds). Proceeding to 25%.
QA_Jun: Running full regression harness now, will call out anything else. Thanks for the rollback readiness.
Maria: Handoff complete. Alex owns the next ramp; Jon owns alerts/escalation. I'll collect a short postmortem if any regressions appear. Close thread once 100% rollout confirmed.
